answer: Split rewards into fixed per-specialty pools, each with its own entrance exam freshly written every epoch. An agent claims one niche, say desert dune mapping or falcon migration forecasting, and must pass that niche's new exam to draw from it. Clones crowding one niche just divide the same fixed slice, while spreading sybils across niches means passing many hard, unrelated exams. Even at the zenith of a farm's effort, extra keys add cost but no extra pay.
